title: From a screenshot to its destination
summary: Use Omarchy's built-in capture tools for the image, and an optional file shelf when you need to keep it at hand.
body:
Omarchy's current Quattro manual groups screenshots, screen recordings, colour picking and text extraction around the Print Screen key. A screenshot is saved as a PNG and copied to the clipboard, which is enough for a direct paste into another app. The capture menu is also available for keyboards without Print Screen.

When the file needs to wait while you switch tasks, Shelf can hold its local path at a screen edge. Drag the saved screenshot from your file manager onto the shelf, then into the destination that accepts file drops. Removing it from the shelf leaves the screenshot on disk.

Use the built-in route first; add the shelf only if that extra handoff step helps. The capture shortcuts are documented for current Quattro and may differ on an older Omarchy installation. This is a suggested workflow based on the linked documentation, not an integration guarantee.
